jobs.age: 18-42 Years (Senior Analyst), 18-32 Years (Laboratory Assistant), 18-30 Years (Laboratory Attendant) — as on the date of interview
jobs.details: Central University of Punjab, Bathinda (CUPB) invites online applications under Advertisement No. CUPB/26-27/012 dated 02.09.2026 for 06 contractual non-teaching posts on a walk-in-interview basis: Senior Analyst (01-UR) for the Food Testing Laboratory under the Central Instrumental Laboratory, Laboratory Assistant (01-UR) under the Department of Biotechnology & Bioinformatics, Laboratory Assistant (01-UR) under the Department of Community Medicine & Health, Laboratory Attendant (01-OBC) under the Self-financed Courses in the Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences & Natural Products, and Laboratory Assistant (01-OBC) and Laboratory Attendant (01-UR) under the Self-financed Courses in the Department of Computer Science & Technology. Emoluments range from Rs. 28,800/- to Rs. 65,000/- per month for 89 days to one year. Corrigenda dated 08.09.2026 and 11.09.2026 and Updated Details dated 08.09.2026 have been published by the university; the Senior Analyst round (last date and interview 11.09.2026) is already over. No separate call letters are issued — candidates who applied by the last date must report for the interview at CUPB, Badal-Bathinda Road, V.P.O. Ghudda, Bathinda.
howToApply: Apply online only through the CUPB non-teaching recruitment portal https://cupnt.samarth.edu.in/ (Sign Up, then apply) — apply separately (with a separate fee) for each post.
Deposit the application fee of Rs. 100/- (exempted for SC/ST/PWD/Women candidates) while filling the online form, on or before the last date of the concerned post.
Read the corrigendum dated 08.09.2026, the Updated Details dated 08.09.2026 and the corrigendum dated 11.09.2026 together with the advertisement.
Carry the printed online application form and all original certificates ( caste, education, AADHAR, experience) to the interview; eligibility is decided at the interview itself.

jobs.details: AIIMS, Bathinda invited applications (Advt. No. AIIMS/BTI/RC/Faculty/2026/2373 dated 31.07.2026) for 77 Faculty (Group-A) posts on direct recruitment basis across its departments — 17 Professor, 05 Additional Professor, 23 Associate Professor and 32 Assistant Professor posts, category-wise breakup as printed in the advertisement. The last date for receipt of applications was extended upto 31.08.2026, 17:00 hrs (Last Date Extension Notice AIIMS/BTI/RC/Faculty/2026/2395 dated 22.08.2026): the mandatory Google Form had to be submitted by 28.08.2026 and the duly signed hard copy with self-attested documents had to reach the Institute by 31.08.2026. howToApply: Read the advertisement and Annexure-A (Essential Eligibility Criteria) uploaded with it on the AIIMS Bathinda website.

Submit the mandatory Google Form before its closing time, then send the duly filled application form with self-attested supporting documents by post / in person so that it reaches the Institute by the last date.
Note that no separate call letter is mailed for the interview — check www.aiimsbathinda.edu.in for eligibility lists and the interview schedule.
